Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: Xbox's splash - the white Xbox sphere logo fading in from near-black against a pure black screen and holding.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Pure black screen. At dead center, the Xbox sphere logo emerges from near-invisible dark gray to full white, holds at center, and remains as the app loads beneath.

## Motion spec
Pattern: single-element luminance fade-in.
- The logo starts at ~8% white (barely discernible on black) and fades to 100% white over 1.4s (ease-out) - no scale, no position change.
- At full brightness, a barely-there glow halo blooms around the sphere (blur radius ~24px, opacity to 0.15 over 400ms).
- Hold at full white for ~1s, then the logo dims to 85% as the dashboard/home UI fades up around it (crossfade 500ms), the logo settling into its header position if the layout requires it, otherwise simply crossfading out.

## Calibration
- Center placement is exact - the logo never moves during the fade.
- The fade is luminance-only; any scale or slide breaks the restraint that makes it feel premium.

## Reduced motion
Logo appears at full white without the fade.

## Don't miss
- Background stays pure #000 the whole time - the phone bezel frames a void.
- No spinner, no wordmark, no sound cue in the visuals - the logo alone carries the splash.
